title: Paid Leave: Billing Statements and Late Fees
issuer: Washington Employment Security Department, Paid Family and Medical Leave

passages.question: What do a late Paid Leave report and overdue premiums cost?
passages.excerpt: Starting August 2026, Paid Leave began applying interest to overdue premium balances, with penalties for missing reports coming soon. ... Late payments: Starting August 2026: A one percent (1%) monthly interest charge will be applied to overdue premium balances. Late reports: Upcoming: Penalties will be assessed on late reports. Penalty schedule: First late report = Warning notice Second late report = $75 penalty Third late report = $150 penalty Additional late reports = $250 penalty
